hook.head: Write a website brief with AI.
hook.vo: Before you build a website, write a brief. Here's how, with AI.

tips.vo: Start with one goal. More orders, more bookings, or more calls. Ask Claude to keep every section focused on that goal.
tips.head: One goal.

msgs: My goal: more pickup orders for my café
Great. Every section will push people to order.

tips.vo: Describe your customer. Students near campus? Families on weekends? The words and the design change for each one.
tips.head: Who is the customer?

tips.vo: Ask Claude to list the sections in order, with one sentence for each. Now you have a plan before a single line of code.
tips.head: List the sections.

cta.head: Save this for later.
cta.vo: Save this for later... and follow Pixel and Co, for more.
